statusTip.signed: You are coming and will play.
statusTip.tentative: Not sure yet – the organisers will not count on you.
statusTip.late: You are coming, but later. Also possible after the signup deadline.
statusTip.bench: You step in when someone is missing.
statusTip.absence: You are not coming. Always possible until the raid starts.

page.title: Signups
page.noCharTipSub: To sign up you need a character with a spec in your profile. Click to open My profile.
page.noCharLink: Add a character to your profile
page.raidHelperError: Raid-Helper unreachable – some events may be missing: {error}
page.empty: There are no upcoming raids you can see right now.

row.selectTipSub: Pick several raids and sign up for them at once with “Sign up for all selected”.
row.discordTipSub: This event runs through Raid-Helper – signing up is the widget below the event post.
row.latePossible: You can still sign off or say “Late”.

dialog.deadlineHint: Signup deadline passed – only Sign off or Late now.
dialog.noCharBefore: Your profile has no character yet.
dialog.noVersionChar: This raid is {version} – your profile has no {version} character yet.
dialog.noVersionCharLink: Create a {version} character in your profile
dialog.notAfterDeadline: No longer available after the signup deadline.
dialog.mixedStatus: Your characters have different statuses – this sets them all to one.
dialog.canAlsoHint: Prefilled from your profile. The organisers see this in the setup.
dialog.commentPlaceholder: e.g. will be about 10 min late
dialog.wishOn: Your wish from the profile is taken into account in the setup.
dialog.wishOff: Wishes are not taken into account in the setup for this event.
dialog.noteTip: The bot posts it in the raid lead's channel.
dialog.notePlaceholderTentative: e.g. not sure yet, maybe later

bulk.hint: Whatever does not fit a raid (deadline, class, raider role) is skipped there, with the reason.

picks.firstChoiceSub: The character you would most like to bring.
picks.canAlsoWithSub: The organisers take it if it suits the raid better.
picks.statusTipSub: Applies to this line only – the switch below sets them all at once.
picks.hint: 1 = your choice, the others “can also come with”. The organisers put you in with exactly one.

availability.title: Absence & attendance
availability.tipSub: Enter when you are away or sure to be there – the bot signs you off from or up for every raid in that period, also for raids created later.
availability.byOrgaTip: The raid lead entered this for you.
availability.removeText: New raids in the period are then no longer changed automatically. Existing signups and sign-offs stay as they are.

dialog.noRaids: No raid in this period yet.
dialog.hintAbsence: Raids created later in this period sign you off automatically. Every change comes as a DM.
dialog.hintPresence: Raids created later in this period sign you up automatically. Every change comes as a DM.
dialog.hintAbsenceFor: Raids created later in this period sign {name} off automatically. Every change goes to {name} as a DM.
dialog.hintPresenceFor: Raids created later in this period sign {name} up automatically. Every change goes to {name} as a DM.
